title: Trump Optimistic on U.S.-Ukraine Talks Amid Global Tensions
description: U.S. President Donald Trump expressed optimism about U.S.-Ukraine negotiations in Saudi Arabia, hinting at the nearly complete lift of an intelligence pause with Ukraine. He dismissed concerns regarding military drills by Russia, China, and Iran, and suggested a potential minerals agreement between the U.S. and Ukraine, urging a desire for peace.

title: Donald Trump says Ukraine 'may not survive' war against Russia even if US support continues
description: Donald Trump suggested in an interview with Fox News that Ukraine's resistance against Russia's land, air and sea invasion may fail even if the US were to continue supporting Kyiv. It comes after the US president's decision to suspend aid and intelligence to Ukraine.

title: Trump Anticipates Positive Outcomes from U.S.-Ukraine Talks
description: President Donald Trump expressed optimism regarding U.S. discussions with Ukraine in Saudi Arabia. He stated the administration is nearing the end of an intelligence pause on Ukraine, is evaluating tariffs on Russia, and is unconcerned about military drills involving Russia, China, and Iran.

title: Zelensky heads to Saudi Arabia for US crunch talks
description: Ukraine’s president has been told he must be willing to cede land occupied by Russia if he wants Washington to lift its ban on weapons and intelligence sharing.

title: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio to meet Ukrainian counterparts in Saudi Arabia this week
description: Rubio spoke with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha on Friday and said President Donald Trump wanted to end the Russia-Ukraine war as soon as possible

title: Church communities rally continued support for local Ukrainian Refugee Fund
description: Since Russia invaded Ukraine on Feb. 24, 2022, St. Andrew's Presbyterian Church, partnered alongside Knox Church, has provided financial support to Ukrainians fleeing the war

title: How a gas pipeline helped Russia mount a rear strike against Ukrainian troops in Kursk
description: Russian forces made use of an underground gas pipeline to attack Ukrainian troops in Sudzha in Kursk in a surprise assault. The pipeline was once a major route for Russian natural gas exports to Europe via Ukraine

title: Ukraine war latest: Russian troops 'use gas pipeline' to surprise Ukrainian forces in Kursk
description: Russian forces have reportedly emerged from abandoned gas pipelines in Kursk to launch a surprise attack on Ukrainian units.
